card.name: Partway through names and foreign words
card.fires_on: Short first pieces of a name or word that is split up, such as a capital K starting a surname or place, or the middle of a Spanish word. The rest of the word follows right after.

modes.label: Start of proper names
modes.description: A capital K or similar opening piece of a surname or place name, with the rest of the name still to come.
modes.example: Kolleru Lake is the largest freshwater lake and is located in Andhra Pradesh.<< K>>olleru is located between Krishna and God

modes.label: Inside Spanish or long words
modes.description: A middle piece of a Spanish word or a long English or chemical word.
modes.example: ​Medicamento Homeopatico. Venta bajo prescripcion medica. Mant<<eng>>ase fuera del alcance de los niños

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing a word or name with its remaining letters, with odd side effects on tokens like 'rest' and 'of'.
card.plain: It fires when a name or foreign word has only just begun and the rest of the letters still need to come.
